nodes.label: OCR
nodes.role: A provider reads a photographed report into text lines. A mock provider is the default and Tesseract is the real one.
nodes.limitation: OCR degrades on rotated or angled images, and raw outputs are not committed.

nodes.label: Lab report check
nodes.role: A conservative detector decides whether the text looks like a lab report. If not, the type is unknown and zero rows are returned.

evidence.text: A receipt returned the type unknown and 0 rows.

nodes.label: Metadata
nodes.role: Reads patient, date and lab fields where present. With the header cropped out, metadata is null.

evidence.text: With the header cropped out, metadata is null and 4 rows are recovered.

nodes.label: Value parser
nodes.role: Reads the value column as a plain number, a qualified number, a range or a scientific value. Anything that matches none of those forms returns no value.
nodes.why: A value that does not match a known form is not repaired or guessed.

io.in: The value text of one row.
io.out: A value with its kind, operator, numbers and the raw text, or none.

nodes.decision: Reject malformed values, and do not correct OCR using knowledge of the source document.
nodes.failure: A wrong value that is still well formed parses as valid, for example <8.5 read in place of <0.5.
nodes.control: No match returns none, and the row is omitted.

evidence.text: The README records Tesseract reading CRP <0.5 as RP <8.5 and 1.2 x 10^3 as 1.2 x 1043.
evidence.caveat: Author-reported evaluation; raw OCR outputs are not committed.

nodes.limitation: There is no confidence measure, so the parser cannot detect a misread that is still a valid number.

nodes.label: Row omission
nodes.role: Drops a row whose value does not parse. A row that does parse keeps its raw line.
nodes.why: A made-up value is worse than a missing row.

io.out: A result row with its raw line, or no row.

nodes.failure: An omitted row is silent: the response does not list what was dropped.
nodes.control: A value of none returns no row.

evidence.text: Recorded examples: with the header cropped out, 4 rows are recovered; a receipt returns the type unknown and 0 rows.

nodes.limitation: The OCR text of dropped rows is not returned.
